documentation.content: A recipe text or picture provider answered that its prepaid balance or spending limit is exhausted (`provider_out_of_credit`, with `provider`, `model`, `surface` `text` / `image`; never the provider's own message). Requests went to the profile's fallback, or to the default provider (Gemini / Vertex AI) when none is named, and anything not made was given back by the usual rules. Top up the provider's account (or raise its spending limit), or switch to a profile that does not use it. See functions/README.md, "Adding a provider" and "Alerts".
